page.registrationOpenIntro: Nominations are open. Follow these steps to enter.
page.registrationClosedIntro: The entry window is closed. These steps explain how submissions were made for this programme.
page.openProgrammesEmptyText: No programmes are currently open for submissions.

faq.question: Does the entering firm or individual need to be a subscriber to WealthBriefing?

children.text: No, this program is open to all firms and individuals active in wealth management or the family office sectors.

faq.question: Can my firm enter more than one category?

children.text: Yes, we encourage firms to enter as many awards that are applicable to their business.

faq.question: Do I need to use the submission form provided?

children.text: Yes, submissions shall only be accepted when using this document.

faq.question: Is there any upfront cost to enter?

children.text: No, there is no upfront cost to enter, but you will be offered the chance to purchase a winner’s marketing package should you be successful. The judging process is completely independent of the commercial arrangements between the participants and the organizers. However, it is expected that when the results are made public, winners will engage with the organizers to promote their win.

faq.question: Is the process open to firms that are not currently active within the USA, Canada, Latin America or Mexico regions?

children.text: The judges will only consider submissions from firms that are demonstrably active in the region. Please see an overview of our global awards programmes

faq.question: How do you ensure that the judging process is independent and impartial?

children.text: The judges are independent of the award organizers ensuring they are divided into separate panels to avoid conflicts of interest.

faq.question: Can you assure me that any details that I submit will be treated with confidentiality?

children.text: We only share submissions with the panel responsible for judging those particular categories. Furthermore, our experienced team ensures that there is no conflict of interest before they share an entrant’s submission with anyone. All our judges have signed a Non-Disclosure Agreement.

faq.question: My submission is likely to be longer than the 1,000-word max limit. Would this disadvantage me?

children.text: We have set the limit out of respect to the judges and we are keen to maintain this to ensure that there is a level playing field between competing submissions. Judges reserve the right to refuse to review submissions that do not comply. We also discourage adding attachments to the submissions.

faq.question: Do I need to submit a separate submission for each category?

children.text: You will need to do a new form for each submission and you should also ensure that this specifically relates to the category for which you are entering. If you are using the same answers for multiple submissions this could result in your entry being marked down by the judging panel.

faq.question: Where is the winner’s announcement shared?

children.text: A public announcement will be made across
editorial platforms, website, and social media channels.

faq.question: Can I speak to anyone on the team about my entry?

children.text: Yes, our experienced team is always available to assist you with preparation of your submission/s and any aspects of the process from start to finish. For any questions please contact
